reference_sql:
WITH promo AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT promo_id, start_date
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), during AS (
  -- one row per promotion that started in 2025
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM promo p
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.order_line_id = ol.order_line_id
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
), baseline AS (
  -- one row per promotion with a baseline sale
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date BETWEEN p.start_date - 14 AND p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(d.revenue, 0) AS promo_revenue, COALESCE(b.revenue, 0) AS baseline_revenue
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN during d ON d.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN baseline b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id

solver.query:
WITH promo AS (
  SELECT promo_id, start_date, end_date
  FROM promotions
  WHERE start_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), on_promo AS (
  SELECT ol.promo_id, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM sales s
  JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_line_id = s.order_line_id
  WHERE ol.promo_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ol.promo_id
), base AS (
  SELECT p.promo_id, SUM(s.net_revenue_eur) AS revenue
  FROM promo p
  JOIN promotion_products pp ON pp.promo_id = p.promo_id
  JOIN sales s ON s.product_id = pp.product_id
    AND s.order_date >= p.start_date - 14
    AND s.order_date <= p.start_date - 1
  GROUP BY p.promo_id
)
SELECT p.promo_id, COALESCE(o.revenue, 0) AS promo_revenue, COALESCE(b.revenue, 0) AS baseline_revenue
FROM promo p
LEFT JOIN on_promo o ON o.promo_id = p.promo_id
LEFT JOIN base b ON b.promo_id = p.promo_id
